title: Bosses + Steam Playtest
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
Just wanted to share the boss and world boss (at the end) that I’ve been working on. 0.2.15 has also been approved for the Steam playtest! This update I focused a lot on improving the combat and incremental systems, lots more coming on the way. I’m very excited to build out The One Who Never Logged Off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5079020/Neverrest/

If you do end up trying it out I’d love to hear your feedback it is greatly appreciated and lets me keep improving. If you do enjoy the game I’d also like to ask for your support with a wishlist. 🙏
